subject.title: fix(mxc): bound sandbox policy file reads to prevent OOM

question: Should MXC sandbox-policy paths become a strict regular-file-only contract, even when existing operator configuration uses a symlink?
rationale: The memory cap is a narrow hardening improvement, but rejecting symlinks changes a previously accepted configuration path and requires a deliberate security-versus-upgrade compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Use or add a bounded read path that retains the prior policy-path behavior while enforcing the 1 MiB limit.

options.title: Adopt strict regular files
options.body: Approve symlink rejection as the permanent MXC policy contract and require explicit upgrade documentation plus tests for the new failure mode.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
recommendation.body: Use or add a bounded read path that retains the prior policy-path behavior while enforcing the 1 MiB limit.
